question: Where is the Dhamek Stupa located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarnath, Varanasi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **deer park is symbolised by the Dhamek Stupa** (Rishipattana). According to legend, this park holds immense significance since it was where **Buddha delivered his first lecture** to his followers after achieving enlightenment and revealed his** "Eightfold Path."**
 
• The **massive Dhamek Stupa, **also known as the **Sarnath Buddha,** is located in the Indian state of **Uttar Pradesh 13 kilometres** from Varanasi. **Stupas first appeared as pre-Buddhist tumuli **called chaitya, where ascetics were buried while seated.
 
• **Stupas built by King Ashoka** contained small bits of calcined bone and other relics of the Buddha and his followers. There is an Ashoka pillar nearby that has an **edict written on it. **
 
• One of the most significant attractions in **Sarnath is the Dhamek Stupa, **which is primarily because of its age and significance as the location of the **Buddha's first sermon**. He revealed the eight-fold path leading to nirvana at this point. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​A sacred Jains location called** Pawapuri or Pawa is situated in the Nalanda** district of the eastern Indian state of Bihar. Rajgir, the capital of Bihar, is located about 19 kilometres away, and Patna is 101 kilometres away. **Jains visit Pawapuri, the site of Mahavira's nirvana,** as a destination of** pilgrimage.**
 
• Bihar, a state in northeastern India, has the** settlement of Bodh Gaya**. The historic brick Mahabodhi Temple Complex, created to commemorate the location where the** Buddha obtained enlightenment beneath** a revered Bodhi Tree, dominates this site, which is regarded as one of the most significant **Buddhist pilgrimage sites. **
 
• In the central region of **Madhya Pradesh**, 46 kilometres to the northeast of Bhopal, and 10 kilometres from Besnagar or Vidisha, is Sanchi Town, a **Nagar Panchayat close to Raisen Town in Raisen District. **
